tools.name: search_credits
tools.description:
Find free credits, free tiers, trials and startup, student or open-source programs from AI, GPU, cloud,
        database and developer-tool providers. Results come with who can get each one, what it needs and links.

tools.name: credits_for_stack
tools.description:
For a codebase: given the services it uses, list the free credits and programs each one's provider
        offers. Read package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Dockerfiles, Terraform and .env.example
        first and pass every external service you find.

tools.name: get_credit_program
tools.description: One program in full: the offer, who qualifies, every requirement, how long it lasts and its links.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
search_credits in the shape ChatGPT's deep research and company knowledge use: ids, titles and links.
        Pass an id to fetch. Other apps: use search_credits, which has eligibility and no-card filters.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: get_credit_program in the shape ChatGPT's deep research and company knowledge use.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description:

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Read a specific offer's source, eligibility gates, public code if known, and community reports.

tools.name: build_credit_stack
tools.description:

tools.description: Read your own queued request and any candidate matches. Requires the same caller identity.

findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_promotion_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_promotion_code · Private data: search_credits, request_promotion, claim_offer, submit_promotion_code · Public sink: claim_offer, submit_promotion_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_promotion_code · Private data: search_credits, request_promotion, claim_offer, submit_promotion_code · Public sink: claim_offer, submit_promotion_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
